zones.name: Sunlit Clearing
zones.role: Spawn, route choice, practice and shared finish. Preserve the existing woodland as a compact home-course exhibit, rather than stretching its mesh.
zones.beats: Grounded start; small ramp, jump, climb and safe glide practice; finish plinth.

zones.name: Mosswood Hollow
zones.role: Wide forest-floor paths, readable roots and low stone shelves. Beginner route and primary reference match.
zones.beats: Three short jump choices; root bridge; walkable recovery trail beneath.

zones.name: Brookbend
zones.role: Shallow river, stepping stones, broad banks and a low bridge. Connect river return to the hub.
zones.beats: Bank-to-bank crossing; optional stepping stones; low water recovery.

zones.name: Rootbound Ruins
zones.role: Root-wrapped pale arches, terraces and a ruined stair court. Vertical progression without a full castle.
zones.beats: Step and landing rhythm; two traversable arch openings; switchback fallback.

zones.name: Heartwood Crossing
zones.role: Central giant tree landmark and route interchange. See three destinations without dense canopy hiding them.
zones.beats: Broad tree-root ring; grounded route anchor; two local return links.

zones.name: Canopy Ridge
zones.role: High stone-and-root ridge with tree crowns beside the route, not a thin branch maze.
zones.beats: Two shelf ascents; visible launch and landing pairs; canopy overlook.

zones.name: River Cliffs
zones.role: Eastern gorge with waterfall and wide long-glide landings. Highest speed and strongest recovery needs.
zones.beats: Three staged glides; two bounded wind columns; lower riverbank return.

zones.name: Windcrown
zones.role: Northern summit, single hero arch and long woodland vista. End of the high circuit, not a separate biome.
zones.beats: Summit approach; broad rest terrace; controlled descent toward canopy.

routes.name: Forest Floor
routes.beats: 7 anchors; 2 optional gaps; 1 optional wind lift
routes.time: 7-11 min first pass; walkable primary route

routes.name: Canopy Ridge
routes.time: 7-11 min first pass; ascent and broad landings

routes.name: River Cliffs
routes.time: 8-12 min first pass; high and low return routes

routes.name: Great Woodland Expedition
routes.beats: 16 ordered anchors chosen from the same 24; no new geometry
routes.time: 14-22 min first exploration; practice time excluded
